reason: CAPE COD: adults in ICU for severe CAP. Served counts 25/400 vs 47/395 printed. TIMEPOINT: day 28, served under '30-day or in-hospital' (within the declared window). 795 of 800 randomised analysed (near-ITT; label imprecise).
reviewed_note: CAPE COD: adults in ICU for severe CAP. Served counts 25/400 vs 47/395 printed. TIMEPOINT: day 28, served under '30-day or in-hospital' (within the declared window). 795 of 800 randomised analysed (near-ITT; label imprecise).

population.span: we assigned adults who had been admitted to the intensive care unit (ICU) for severe community-acquired pneumonia

endpoint.span: The primary outcome was death at 28 days.

estimate.span: By day 28, death had occurred in 25 of 400 patients (6.2%; 95% confidence interval [CI], 3.9 to 8.6) in the hydrocortisone group and in 47 of 395 patients (11.9%; 95% CI, 8.7 to 15.1) in the placebo group (absolute difference, -5.6 percentage points; 95% CI, -9.6 to -1.7; P = 0.006).

ci.span: (absolute difference, -5.6 percentage points; 95% CI, -9.6 to -1.7; P = 0.006)

treatment_strategy.span: to receive intravenous hydrocortisone (200 mg daily for either 4 or 7 days as determined by clinical improvement, followed by tapering for a total of 8 or 14 days) or to receive placebo. All the patients received standard therapy, including antibiotics and supportive care.

follow_up.span: The primary outcome was death at 28 days.

entry_population_reading.span: we assigned adults who had been admitted to the intensive care unit (ICU) for severe community-acquired pneumonia

analysis_set.absent_reason: The abstract states that 800 patients underwent randomization and data from 795 were analyzed, but no held source identifies the analysis set as ITT, mITT, per-protocol, safety, or all randomized.

entry_population.extractor_why: Adults admitted to an ICU for severe community-acquired pneumonia fall within the question's hospitalized adult population; ITT status remains unverified.

extractor_mismatch_note: The served arm-level counts match the abstract, but apply to day 28 rather than the specified 30-day or in-hospital timepoint. The served intention-to-treat label is not established by the held sources. The reported between-arm estimate and CI are an absolute risk difference, not an RR; no RR or RR CI is printed.
